Are you open to work with external companies? Discover the main public and private funding schemes available to researchers.

Public and private funding schemes for industrial oriented collaborations

For schemes that require contract negotiation or IP support, please contact USI Transfer.
For any questions about academic support and grants, please contact the Research Service.

Innosuisse – the Swiss Innovation Agency – supports funding of innovative projects to bring them to the market. Projects have to demonstrate a considerable innovation potential and a clear business idea. Innosuisse main goal is to advance the current state of research of high-risk projects.

The funding is conceived for promoting collaborative research between companies and academic researchers. Academic researchers eventually need to find an implementation partner to access the main funding scheme. As USI Transfer we can help you.

  • Innovation project with implementation partners

Researchers collaborating with a Swiss industrial partner (SMEs, startups or other organisations with fewer than 250 full-time equivalents) can benefit from a voucher worth up to 15,000 Swiss francs to assess the feasibility, innovation and market potential of an innovative idea:

  • Innovation cheque

Academic researchers without an implementation partner can start working on innovation projects with two main schemes:

  • BRIDGE programmes in collaboration with SNSF
  • Innovation project without implementation partners

For support on preparing your application and to learn about other funding opportunities please visit our Research support dedicated webpage.
